"""V1-final attacks through the real negative() shell body (frozen harness call_negative), plus fail-closed probes."""

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "humansearch" / "tests"))
from test_hs_0002 import call_negative, clean_env, extract_negative_function  # noqa: E402

CANON = "PR #13 행의 대상 칸에 다른 대상 1개가 함께 적혀 있다 — 대상마다 자기 행이 있어야 한다"
CASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = [
    ("intended", "FAIL: CI 배선 불량 — 본 검사=명령다름", "CI 배선 불량", 0),
    ("bait-then-real", "PASS: CI 배선 불량\nFAIL: CI 배선 불량", "CI 배선 불량", 0),
    ("only-bait", "PASS: CI 배선 불량\nFAIL: 다른 사유", "CI 배선 불량", 1),
    ("expected-newline-argv", "FAIL: CI 배선 불량", "CI 배선 불량\nFAIL: x", 1),
    ("expected-cr-argv", "FAIL: CI 배선 불량", "CI 배선 불량\r", 1),
    ("expected-shell-metachars", "FAIL: $(echo hi) `id` ; rm", "$(echo hi) `id` ; rm", 0),
    ("expected-shell-metachars-absent", "FAIL: hi", "$(echo hi)", 1),
    ("expected-glob", "FAIL: something", "*", 1),
    ("expected-dash-dash", "FAIL: -- x", "--", 0),
    ("expected-leading-dash", "FAIL: -n", "-n", 0),
    ("legacy-canonical", f"FAIL: {CANON}", "대상 칸에 다른 대상", 0),
    ("legacy-zero", f"FAIL: {CANON.replace('1개', '0개')}", "대상 칸에 다른 대상", 1),
    ("legacy-bare", "FAIL: 대상 칸에 다른 대상", "대상 칸에 다른 대상", 1),
    ("legacy-multi-one", "FAIL: PR #13 행이 1개 — 같은 대상에 처분이 둘 이상이면 결론이 무엇인지 정해지지 않는다", "처분이 둘 이상", 1),
    ("blank-expected", "FAIL: x", "   ", 1),
    ("empty-expected", "FAIL: x", "", 1),
    ("extension", "FAIL: CI 배선 불량XYZ", "CI 배선 불량", 1),
    ("emdash-attached", "FAIL: CI 배선 불량—x", "CI 배선 불량", 1),
    ("slash-detail", "FAIL: CI 배선 불량/x", "CI 배선 불량", 0),
]


def unreadable_out_log_case(tmp: Path) -> dict:
    """run_target writes out.log then makes it unreadable: helper exit 2 must become FAIL (fail-closed)."""
    tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    harness = tmp / "call-negative-unreadable.sh"
    script = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
TMP="$1"; EXPECT="$2"; WT="$TMP/fixture"; mkdir -p "$WT"; printf 'clean\\n' > "$WT/changed.txt"
checked=0; fail=0
pass() {{ echo "PASS: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); }}
failc() {{ echo "FAIL: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); fail=1; }}
make_fixture() {{ return 0; }}
tree_hash() {{ shasum "$WT/changed.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1; }}
run_target() {{ printf 'FAIL: CI 배선 불량\\n' > "$TMP/out.log"; chmod 000 "$TMP/out.log"; echo 1; }}
{extract_negative_function()}
negative fixture 'printf changed > "$WT/changed.txt"' "$EXPECT"
chmod 644 "$TMP/out.log"
echo "CHECKED: $checked"
exit "$fail"
"""
    harness.write_text(script, encoding="utf-8")
    proc = subprocess.run(["bash", str(harness), str(tmp), "CI 배선 불량"], cwd=ROOT, env=clean_env(), text=True,
                          capture_output=True, check=False)
    return {"name": "unreadable-out-log-fail-closed", "wanted_exit": 1, "exit": proc.returncode,
            "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr[-300:], "ok": proc.returncode == 1 and proc.stdout.startswith("FAIL: ")}


def wrong_cwd_case(tmp: Path) -> dict:
    """negative() resolves the helper relative to cwd; from another cwd the check must not turn green."""
    tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    harness = tmp / "call-negative-cwd.sh"
    script = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
TMP="$1"; EXPECT="$2"; WT="$TMP/fixture"; mkdir -p "$WT"; printf 'clean\\n' > "$WT/changed.txt"
checked=0; fail=0
pass() {{ echo "PASS: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); }}
failc() {{ echo "FAIL: $1"; checked=$((checked+1)); fail=1; }}
make_fixture() {{ return 0; }}
tree_hash() {{ shasum "$WT/changed.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1; }}
run_target() {{ printf 'FAIL: CI 배선 불량\\n' > "$TMP/out.log"; echo 1; }}
{extract_negative_function()}
negative fixture 'printf changed > "$WT/changed.txt"' "$EXPECT"
echo "CHECKED: $checked"
exit "$fail"
"""
    harness.write_text(script, encoding="utf-8")
    proc = subprocess.run(["bash", str(harness), str(tmp), "CI 배선 불량"], cwd=tmp, env=clean_env(), text=True,
                          capture_output=True, check=False)
    return {"name": "wrong-cwd-helper-missing-fail-closed", "wanted_exit": 1, "exit": proc.returncode,
            "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr[-300:], "ok": proc.returncode == 1 and proc.stdout.startswith("FAIL: ")}


def main() -> int:
    results = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hs0002-v1-final-adv-neg-") as folder:
        tmp = Path(folder)
        for name, out_log, expect, wanted in CASES:
            case_dir = tmp / name.replace("/", "_")
            case_dir.mkdir()
            proc = call_negative(case_dir, out_log, expect)
            first = proc.stdout.splitlines()[0] if proc.stdout else ""
            results.append({"name": name, "out_log": out_log, "expected": expect, "wanted_exit": wanted,
                            "exit": proc.returncode, "first_line": first[:200], "checked_1": "CHECKED: 1" in proc.stdout,
                            "ok": proc.returncode == wanted and "CHECKED: 1" in proc.stdout
                            and first.startswith("PASS: " if wanted == 0 else "FAIL: ")})
        results.append(unreadable_out_log_case(tmp / "unreadable"))
        results.append(wrong_cwd_case(tmp / "cwd"))
    mismatches = [r["name"] for r in results if not r["ok"]]
    report = {"verifier": "claude-v1-final", "ran": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "python": sys.executable,
              "total": len(results), "mismatches": mismatches, "results": results}
    (ART / "v1-final-adv-negative-path.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for r in results:
        print(f"{'OK ' if r['ok'] else 'MISMATCH'} {r['name']:40} wanted={r['wanted_exit']} got={r['exit']}")
    print(f"total={len(results)} mismatches={mismatches}")
    return int(bool(mismatches))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    sys.exit(main())
